about.title: Downey Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: Downey is home to about 114,000 people in southeast Los Angeles County, and its main boulevards stay busy from morning to night. Public collision records for 2025 list 829 injury crashes inside the city, with 1,234 people hurt and 6 lives lost. Lakewood Boulevard, Firestone Boulevard, Florence Avenue and Paramount Boulevard appear most often in those reports, and Friday afternoons between 3 and 5 p.m. show the highest counts. Those are simply the numbers; what matters after a crash is what happens next for you. California uses pure comparative fault, so you can still pursue a claim even if part of the blame lands on you. You generally have two years to file, and far less if a city or county vehicle was involved. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that connects you with an independent Downey-area car accident attorney who works on contingency, meaning no fee unless your case recovers money.

whyChoose.title: Why Downey Drivers Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Deadlines Are Tracked From Day One
items.desc: California gives most car accident victims two years to file, but claims involving a public agency can require notice in as little as six months. The attorney you're connected with will pin down which timeline applies to your crash.

items.title: Partial Fault Does Not End Your Claim
items.desc: Under pure comparative fault, your recovery is reduced by your share of responsibility rather than wiped out. An independent attorney can push back when an insurer tries to inflate your percentage.

items.title: No Recorded Statement, No Upfront Cost
items.desc: Before you talk to the other driver's insurer, an attorney can step in so nothing you say is used against you later. Network attorneys work on contingency, so there is no fee unless your case results in a recovery.

items.question: I was hit on Lakewood Boulevard in Downey and the other driver's insurer keeps calling. What should I do?
items.answer: You are not required to give a recorded statement to the other side's insurance company, and it is usually wise to decline until you have spoken with an attorney. Adjusters may ask leading questions designed to shift fault onto you. Save every voicemail and letter, write down what you remember about the crash, and let LawProactive connect you with an attorney who can handle those calls.

items.question: Is there a limit on what I can recover for pain and suffering in California?
items.answer: California places no cap on non-economic damages in a standard car accident case, which covers things like pain, emotional distress and loss of enjoyment of life. The amount depends on the specific facts of your injuries and how they affect your daily routine. No one can promise a figure in advance, but an attorney can explain how these damages are typically evaluated.

items.question: What evidence should I gather after a Downey car crash?
items.answer: Photograph the vehicles, the roadway, skid marks, signals and any visible injuries as soon as you safely can. Get the names of witnesses, request the Downey Police report number, and keep every medical record and bill. Many storefronts and traffic cameras along Firestone and Florence overwrite footage quickly, so an attorney will want to send preservation requests early.
